subject.title: fix(feishu): retry once on token-invalid errors 99991663/99991664 with cache invalidation (fixes #97287)

question: Should this PR become the canonical Feishu invalid-token recovery branch after current-head proof is refreshed, or should maintainers choose a sibling implementation with a narrower cache-invalidation shape?
rationale: Multiple open PRs implement the same 99991663/99991664 recovery, and the remaining choice is about owner preference for cache scope and canonical branch selection rather than a mechanical code defect.

options.title: Refresh proof and keep this branch canonical
options.body: Ask for redacted current-head live Feishu proof, then use this branch as the main candidate because it covers SDK and CardKit caches and the prior compile blocker is fixed.

options.title: Choose a narrower sibling branch
options.body: Select another open candidate if maintainers prefer account-scoped invalidation or a smaller diff, then close this PR as superseded after preserving useful proof context.

options.title: Pause for Feishu owner design
options.body: Hold all candidate branches if Feishu owners want a different cache ownership design before any invalid-token retry lands.

recommendation.title: Refresh proof and keep this branch canonical
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted current-head live Feishu proof, then use this branch as the main candidate because it covers SDK and CardKit caches and the prior compile blocker is fixed.
